name: bare-querystring
usage:
```js
const querystring = require('bare-querystring')

querystring.decode('name=ferret') // `{ name: "ferret" }`

querystring.encode({ name: 'ferret' }) // `name=ferret`
```

exports.name: parse
signatures: parse(input: string, separator?: string, delimiter?: string): Record<string, string | string[]>
exports.description: Parse a query string into an object, splitting pairs on `separator` (default `&`) and key/value on `delimiter` (default `=`). `+` decodes to a space, keys and values are percent-decoded, and repeated keys collect into an array.

params.name: delimiter
params.description: Substring that separates a key from its value (default `'='`).

returns.description: An object (with a `null` prototype) mapping decoded keys to decoded values; repeated keys collect into an array.

exports.name: decode
signatures: decode(input: string, separator?: string, delimiter?: string): Record<string, string | string[]>

params.name: delimiter
params.description: Substring that separates a key from its value (default `'='`).

returns.description: The parsed parameters, exactly as `parse` returns them.

exports.name: stringify
signatures: stringify(params: {}, separator?: string, delimiter?: string): string
exports.description: Serialize an object into a query string, joining pairs with `separator` (default `&`) and key/value with `delimiter` (default `=`). Array values produce one pair per element.

params.name: params
params.description: Object whose enumerable entries become key/value pairs; array values produce one pair per element.

params.name: separator
params.description: Substring used to join key/value pairs (default `'&'`).

params.name: delimiter
params.description: Substring used to join a key to its value (default `'='`).

exports.name: encode
signatures: encode(params: {}, separator?: string, delimiter?: string): string

params.name: params
params.description: Object whose enumerable entries become key/value pairs; array values produce one pair per element.

params.name: separator
params.description: Substring used to join key/value pairs (default `'&'`).

params.name: delimiter
params.description: Substring used to join a key to its value (default `'='`).

returns.description: The percent-encoded query string, exactly as `stringify` returns it.
